issues.summary: Manhole cover loose on Prospect St
issues.description: The manhole cover outside my apartment has come loose again.  The issue was previously fixed last year (https://seeclickfix.com/issues/3216750) and I hope it's possible to repair again.

There’s river behind 81,83 & 85 Fuller street and also affecting some Winthrop street houses. The river seems to over flow with little rain. People around are known for dumping trash there causing it flood our back yards.

Ever since O'Brien Hwy was repaved, it now floods every time it rains.  Presently, there is a lake that covers half the street in front of 4-6 Canal Park, between Cambridge St and Land Blvd, on the Boston-bound side.  The grading of the street no longer drains the water away.

issues.address: Franklin Rd And Massapoag Sharon, Massachusetts
issues.description: The street drains are clear but street is flooded.
